ios.desc:
#1 sleep & relaxation app — now free to try!

The only sleep sounds app designed exclusively for Apple TV, featuring 77 high-fidelity soundscapes, custom mixes, immersive video scenes, guided meditations, and more—delivering the most sounds and features of any sleep and relaxation app on the App Store, all designed to provide the perfect night’s rest and deep relaxation. Now enhanced with Dolby Atmos for stunning, immersive 3D sound!

FEATURES (FREE):

• 9 relaxing sleep sounds:  Heavy Rain, Calm Ocean Beach, White Noise, Waterfall (Dolby Atmos), Air Conditioner, Fireplace, Coffee Shop Ambience, Tropical Jungle, Lullaby

• 1 ambient video visual: Ambient Light

• 1 guided breathing exercise

• Total black screen to keep your room dark while sounds play

• Optional on-screen clock display

• Screensaver protection for uninterrupted relaxation

• Sleep timer to automatically stop playback or close the app

• Offline access—no internet required

• Complete privacy with no tracking, no ads, and no personal data stored


UNLOCK THE FULL EXPERIENCE:

Includes everything in the free version—plus powerful premium features.

• All 77 high-definition sleep sounds, including 17 unique rain soundscapes, white noise, ocean waves, fan, fireplace, ASMR, nature soundscapes, and relaxing music

• 14 exclusive Dolby Atmos soundscapes with lifelike, rich surround sound for a calm, realistic audio experience

• 12 calming video scenes including ocean waves, snowfall, fireplace, forest, and more

• 6 guided breathing exercises for sleep, energy, and relaxation

• 4 guided meditations to help you fall asleep fast

• Create and save your own custom sound mixes with individual volume controls

• Build your own custom sound library with saved favorites

• Dual alarms with snooze, repeat days, and custom sounds—perfect for weekday and weekend wake-ups

• Sunrise alarm that gradually brightens the screen to simulate natural light

• Background audio support for continuous playback while using other apps

• Choose between monthly subscription or lifetime one-time purchase

COMPLETE AUDIO LIBRARY (77 SOUNDS):
